name: Auth - Login flow with JWT authentication
description: Verifies the complete login flow: valid credentials redirect to dashboard, invalid credentials show error, and unauthenticated access redirects to login

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and verify the login form is rendered with email and password fields
Submit with invalid credentials (wrong password) and verify error message is displayed
Assert that the error toast/message appears indicating invalid credentials
Submit with valid seeded test credentials (gerente@cermont.com / test-password) and wait for redirect
Assert that the user is redirected to /dashboard and the sidebar with navigation links is visible
Open browser devtools and verify that an HttpOnly cookie named 'refreshToken' was set
Navigate directly to /dashboard/orders without auth token and verify redirect to /login
